evidence_quotes: Boete op grond van de Meststoffenwet, opgelegd aan een vervoerder van dierlijke meststoffen.
rationale: The decision concerns an administrative fine imposed on a transporter of animal manure under the Dutch Meststoffenwet (Fertilizers Act) and procedural defences regarding evidence disclosure and fair trial principles. Under the protocol rules, Meststoffenwet agricultural manure disputes are explicitly classified as NOT_WATER and not_water_related.
